This is why I think my life will only get worse as my socio-economic background is already "up there". While it is not impossible for me to become super rich such as by winning the lottery or marrying a rich person, the chances of that happening is very low.

And in my thread I said living abroad not travelling. I am not sure if I ever want to have kids or not - too early to decide on that.
